{{PAGENAME}} is produced through [[Alchemy]] at the [[alchemy workbench (tier II)]]. When used the potion applies the {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} buff, increasing the restorative effect of {{Energy}} through food.

==Effect==

On use, digestion potion will apply the digestion potion buff for a duration of 5 minutes. This buff allows the player to regenerate more energy points from food. For a list of all buffs see the [[Effects]] page.
